item.name: Scan a box of 12 identical units
Start picking (paid or cash on delivery)
Hand over to courier (writes off stock)
Request a return (reasons: DEFECTIVE, CHANGED_MIND, DAMAGED, WRONG_ITEM, OTHER)
Create a return for a customer
Inspection: decide each line (RESTOCK / SCRAP / REJECT)
Registry (types: INVOICE, DELIVERY_NOTE, WARRANTY_CARD, RECEIVING_NOTE, TRANSFER_NOTE, RETURN_NOTE, INVENTORY_ACT)
Send a document to the customer
Send a document to another address
